title: The Oracle
summary: The Oracle was a wise man suffering from an unspecified magical curse who was residing in a cave with Lich, deep underground near the Greek coast. He had considerable knowledge on the whereabouts of Atlantis.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
[[Eathon Lambert]] fell into the cave and discovered the Oracle in a decrepit state whilst on his quest to find the ancient [[Amulet of Will]]. Eathon had hoped to find a wise man who could point him in the right direction of [[Atlantis]]. After helping to revive him, Eathon promised to return with a cure for his curse and protected his cave with a magical force barrier. {{source|The Unseen Guide}}

Ten years later, just like his father, [[Lok Lambert]] fell down the hole and into the Oracle's cave. After defeating Lok's [[Freelancer]], the Oracle grabbed Lok. After realising who Lok was and that he had fallen through the barrier with [[Eathon Lambert's journal]], the Oracle, now in his young man form, revealed that the entrance to Atlantis lay at the [[Temple of Poseidon]] before passing on Eathon's message, "those things most precious are often hidden in plain sight". {{source|The Unseen Guide}}

sections.wikitext:
*While it is not revealed what curse the Oracle is suffering from, the afflictions are similar to the [[Curse of the Legendary Titans]], shared by [[Simon Judeau]] and [[Metz]].
*The character is most likely a reference to the [[wikipedia:Pythia|Oracle of Delphi]] in Ancient Greece.
